messages.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement (1)
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement.
The recorded demand forecast for part:360020 changed by +4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09).
Your recorded on-time delivery rate is 85 % (sc:70620@2026Q3).
The referenced orders for part:360020 each record a price of EUR 4.39 per price unit (po:4500014467-10, po:4500014389-10, po:4500014329-10, po:4500014280-20, po:4500014280-10, po:4500014171-10, po:4500014120-10, po:4500013994-10).
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 20,000 pcs per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement (1)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

We appreciate your commitment to a 24-month agreement and the proposed 14-day payment terms. For the package with 14-day payment terms and a 24-month contract, we can offer a price of EUR 4.87 per unit. Otherwise, our offer is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement (2)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Thank you for your revised offer and your continued commitment to a 24-month agreement. Our offer stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

In exchange for the 14-day payment terms, we can offer a slight reduction to EUR 4.86 per unit, giving you an alternative package at a price of €4.86 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Please understand that further price reductions are not possible. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. 

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement (3)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your continued interest in our products and services. We are always glad to work with you and value our business relationship very much. 

Following our recent discussions, our offer is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. As an alternative package, for the package with 14-day payment terms and a 24-month contract, our price remains firm at EUR 4.86 per unit. 

Please understand that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot), as further reductions are not viable for us. This offer stays valid for 7 days. Please decide if you would like to proceed on these terms, and we look forward to hearing from you.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
